notes: Build82 establishes launcher/launcher-runtime.js as the only shipped UI authority. The runtime package contains only manifest.json, extension icons and the canonical launcher. Legacy ui/, diagnostic shells, fab artwork, fallback mount guardians, extension-owned chat, update-manager runtime, background/service-worker code, provider runtimes, storage, network, polling, timers and MutationObserver are absent from the shipped surface. Functional Builds60-75 engines remain source-only for controlled future reattachment through the canonical launcher.
